Walk stopped at **22 498 ms of its full 90 000 ms budget** with `no-usable-key (no-key-scores-above-threshold)` after cube face `+X → +Y`; only KeyW/S/A were re-measured at that recalibration and none projected above `minScore=0.15`. I did not touch the steering threshold or any footing/reference/route predicate — that is controller logic, not the concrete binding/API fault my remit allows fixing, and a same-budget retry would face the identical 94.5u multi-face traverse.
